scenes.basis: 4:1 "As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them" - the arrest follows the temple scenes of 3:11-26
4:5 "their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem"
4:23 "Being let go, they came to their own company" - the gathering names no place; it follows the Jerusalem council scene of 4:5-22
